scope: Canonical shared speech API synthetic TTS-to-ASR round trips. No microphone or speaker capture, stream/cancellation, full Alpha resident, Gmail/Calendar or user acceptance.

rows.text: Good morning. Let us set up your tablet together.
rows.phonemes: ɡˈʊd mˈɔɹnɪŋ. lˈɛt ˌʌs sˈɛt ˌʌp jʊɹ tˈæblət təɡˈɛðəɹ.
rows.heard: Good morning. Let us set up your tablet together.

rows.text: Please connect to your home wireless network.
rows.phonemes: plˈiz kənˈɛkt tə jʊɹ hˈOm wˈIəɹləs nˈɛtwˌɜɹk.
rows.heard: Please connect to your home wireless network.

rows.text: Tap the large green button when you are ready.
rows.phonemes: tˈæp ðə lˈɑɹʤ ɡɹˈin bˈʌtn wˌɛn ju ɑɹ ɹˈɛdi.
rows.heard: Tap the large green button when you are ready.

rows.text: Your electric bill is due next Friday.
rows.phonemes: jˌʊɹ əlˈɛktɹɪk bˈɪl ɪz dˈu nˈɛkst fɹˈIdˌA.
rows.heard: Your electric bill is due next Friday.

rows.text: I can read your mail out loud whenever you like.
rows.phonemes: ˌI kæn ɹˈid jʊɹ mˈAl ˈWt lˈWd wənˈɛvəɹ ju lˈIk.
rows.heard: I can read your mail out loud whenever you like.

rows.text: Would you like me to call your daughter?
rows.phonemes: wˌʊd ju lˈIk mˌi tə kˈɔl jʊɹ dˈɔTəɹ?
rows.heard: Would you like me to call your daughter?

rows.text: The weather today is sunny and warm.
rows.phonemes: ðə wˈɛðəɹ tədˈA ɪz sˈʌni ænd wˈɔɹm.
rows.heard: The weather today is sunny and warm.

rows.text: Remember to take your medicine after lunch.
rows.phonemes: ɹəmˈɛmbəɹ tə tˈAk jʊɹ mˈɛdəsᵊn ˈæftəɹ lˈʌnʧ.
rows.heard: Remember to take your medicine after lunch.

rows.text: Your doctor appointment is on Tuesday morning.
rows.phonemes: jˌʊɹ dˈɑktəɹ əpˈYntmənt ɪz ˌɔn tˈuzdˌA mˈɔɹnɪŋ.
rows.heard: Your doctor appointment is on Tuesday morning.

rows.text: I did not hear you clearly. Could you say that again?
rows.phonemes: ˌI dˈɪd nˌɑt hˈɪɹ ju klˈɪɹli. kˌʊd ju sˈA ðˈæt əɡˈɛn?
rows.heard: I did not hear you clearly. Could you say that again?

rows.text: Please type the code that was sent to your email.
rows.phonemes: plˈiz tˈIp ðə kˈOd ðæt wʌz sˈɛnt tə jʊɹ ˈimˌAl.
rows.heard: Please type the code that was sent to your email.

rows.text: Your payment was received and you are all set.
rows.phonemes: jˌʊɹ pˈAmᵊnt wʌz ɹəsˈivd ænd ju ɑɹ ˈɔl sˈɛt.
rows.heard: Your payment was received, and you are all set.

rows.text: We can stop here and finish this later.
rows.phonemes: wˌi kæn stˈɑp hˈɪɹ ænd fˈɪnəʃ ðɪs lˈATəɹ.
rows.heard: We can stop here and finish this later.

rows.text: Thank you for your patience while I check that.
rows.phonemes: θˈæŋk ju fɔɹ jʊɹ pˈAʃəns wˌIl ˌI ʧˈɛk ðˈæt.
rows.heard: Thank you for your patience while I check that.

rows.text: Turn the volume up if my voice is too quiet.
rows.phonemes: tˈɜɹn ðə vˈɑljˌum ˌʌp ɪf mI vˈYs ɪz tˈu kwˈIət.
rows.heard: Turn the volume up if my voice is too quiet.

rows.text: This tablet works best when it stays plugged in.
rows.phonemes: ðˌɪs tˈæblət wˈɜɹks bˈɛst wˌɛn ɪt stˈAz plˈʌɡd ˈɪn.
rows.heard: This tablet works best when it stays plugged in.

rows.text: Goodbye for now. I will be here when you need me.
rows.phonemes: ɡˌʊdbˈI fɔɹ nˈW. ˌI wɪl bi hˈɪɹ wˌɛn ju nˈid mˌi.
rows.heard: Goodbye for now. I will be here when you need me.

rows.text: The birch canoe slid on the smooth planks.
rows.phonemes: ðə bˈɜɹʧ kənˈu slˈɪd ˌɔn ðə smˈuð plˈæŋks.
rows.heard: The birch canoe slid on the smooth planks.

rows.text: Glue the sheet to the dark blue background.
rows.phonemes: ɡlˈu ðə ʃˈit tə ðə dˈɑɹk blˈu bˈækɡɹˌWnd.
rows.heard: glue the sheet to the dark blue background.

rows.text: It is easy to tell the depth of a well.
rows.phonemes: ˌɪt ɪz ˈizi tə tˈɛl ðə dˈɛpθ ʌv ɐ wˈɛl.
rows.heard: It is easy to tell the depth of a well.

rows.text: These days a chicken leg is a rare dish.
rows.phonemes: ðˌiz dˈAz ɐ ʧˈɪkən lˈɛɡ ɪz ɐ ɹˈɛɹ dˈɪʃ.

rows.text: Rice is often served in round bowls.
rows.phonemes: ɹˈIs ɪz ˈɔfᵊn sˈɜɹvd ɪn ɹˈWnd bˈOlz.
rows.heard: Rice is often served in round bowls.

rows.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
rows.phonemes: ðə kwˈɪk bɹˈWn fˈɑks ʤˈʌmps ˈOvəɹ ðə lˈAzi dˈɔɡ.
